answer: Make every agent post a refundable bond in basalt-hard escrow before it can transact: the bond is slashed when peers prove one operator controls several identities. Like an oasis that only waters travelers who bring their own supply, one operator cannot cheaply spawn thousands of clones, since each copy must lock fresh capital. Standing then grows on a terrace of attested work, so a new identity cannot buy instant trust; an attacker must pay the bond, wait out the aging window, and risk forfeiture on detection, making mass fakery unprofitable.
